why: The value written is the value compared against, so the branch decides only whether a store of X happens where X is already there. why: `n` is a short and the gate above prints only when `n > 0x7f` as a SIGNED comparison, so every value that reaches the call is in [0x80, 0x7fff] and sign extension and zero extension agree on all of them.  Held fixed: the gate, which the sweep drives at 0x7ffe and 0xfffe precisely because those are the two seg_symcount values that make the increment negative or zero -- and both of those take the return above rather than this call.  The sign extension is transcribed because the object does `movswl`.
